name: procedures
description: Knowledge system: /what-do-i-know router (any record kind — procedures, decisions, solutions, references), /update-records (procedure/decision/solution + templates), /adherence-check cold-read review, a nudge that reminds both exist, and soft-by-default gate hooks — how-do-i-gate (PreToolUse) + am-i-done-gate (Stop), off unless armed — plus evolve-sweep (async Stop detector that wakes the session to dispatch procedure-evolver), from orchard-codex develop-sweatshop.

enable_how_do_i_gate.title: Enable the how-do-i gate
enable_how_do_i_gate.description: Require Skill(how-do-i) before a main agent acts. OFF by default — nudge.sh reminds instead of this gate denying. Set true to enforce; also settable per-invocation as PROCEDURES_ENABLE_HOW_DO_I_GATE=true.

enable_am_i_done_gate.title: Enable the am-i-done gate
enable_am_i_done_gate.description: Require one Skill(am-i-done) review before a turn that used tools ends. OFF by default — nudge.sh reminds instead of this gate blocking. Set true to enforce; also settable per-invocation as PROCEDURES_ENABLE_AM_I_DONE_GATE=true.

enable_frontmatter_check.title: Enable the frontmatter check
enable_frontmatter_check.description: Require the six-key frontmatter schema on records written into a knowledge store. Set false to turn this check off; also settable per-invocation as PROCEDURES_ENABLE_FRONTMATTER_CHECK=false.

enable_evolve_sweep.title: Enable the evolve sweep
enable_evolve_sweep.description: After each tool-using turn, triage the turn's final message with a cheap model and wake the session once when it looks evolvable, so procedure-evolver reviews the full turn and updates records. Set false to turn this off; also settable per-invocation as PROCEDURES_ENABLE_EVOLVE_SWEEP=false.

enable_query_shape_guard.title: Enable the gate-fork shape guard
enable_query_shape_guard.description: Hold the am-i-done work-reviewer fork to its one-shot contract: exactly one retrieval call (the how-do-i.sh pipeline, plus the justfile probe); the fork may not dispatch agents or write. OFF by default, following the two gates above. Set true to enforce; also settable per-invocation as PROCEDURES_ENABLE_QUERY_SHAPE_GUARD=true.

enable_nudge.title: Enable the discovery nudge
enable_nudge.description: Print one reminder per turn that /what-do-i-know and /adherence-check exist. ON by default. Set false to turn this off; also settable per-invocation as PROCEDURES_ENABLE_NUDGE=false.
